<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that breaks an aryl‑halide bond and forms a ketone (Friedel‑Crafts acylation). Since functional‑group based searches returned no matches, we will search only by bond changes: break a C‑Cl bond (6‑8) and form a C‑C bond (6‑6). This should return a template ID that we can then apply to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CNc1c(C(=O)Nc2cccc(OC)c2)nnn1Cc1ccc(CN2CC(F)C2)cc1",
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
